items.title: Lawrence Marrero Interview, 1959-01-02
items.q: You remember some of the fellas uptown like Brock Mumford.

ctx.x: Well I couldn't tell how good he was because I was too small. To remember he's called, you know he's playing when he was my dad and him. That's around 1910. About 10 years old.
You remember some of the fellas uptown like Brock Mumford. Brock who used to play with the Eagle Band.

No. Lorenzo Stoll. Oh Lorenzo Stoll. Yes I know him good. He was a nice musician too. Nice banjo player he was. He was a big banjo player. He was nice too. Also Willie Bonte. Oh yes. I forgot to mention his name. Willie Bonte was a nice guy too. Wonderful banjo player too. Remember Tom Benton.
